allowed_changes: use exact frozen Binance BTCUSDT data and SEC halving-date file
treat USDT as USD-equivalent and convert with identical historical usd_per_cny path used in BTC SMA200-001
restrict execution to BTC x SP500 common sessions for metric comparability
halving date itself is unavailable for exposure; enter on the next common execution session
hold 100% BTC through the 365th calendar day after an observed halving, then cash
report both 2020 and 2024 event-window net returns including entry and exit costs
comparison_gates: Sharpe > BTC buy-and-hold on identical CNY/common-session window
expected_outputs: halving strategy, BTC buy-hold and cash CSVs
2020 and 2024 active-window net returns including entry/exit costs
trade count, max gross, minimum cash and fingerprint
ATM-SVP-3 absolute status + WEAK cap + objective/comparison
follow_up_policy: After formal performance is viewed, do not change the 365-day window, add a pre-halving window, combine technical signals, alter weekend policy, data source or costs. A different supply-cycle hypothesis is a new preregistered lineage, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: using pre-halving windows or estimated future halving dates
combining halving with SMA, momentum, RSI, ATR, MVRV, volume, funding, drawdown or stop-loss rules
adding ETH, QQQ, gold or TLT after results
using weekend execution after seeing common-session results
changing transaction costs or USDT/USD treatment after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: Bitcoin halvings mechanically reduce new-coin issuance. If the supply shock is economically meaningful but price adjustment is not instantaneous, holding BTC for one fixed calendar year after each observed halving may concentrate exposure in the post-supply-shock repricing phase while avoiding much of the multi-year crypto bear-cycle exposure between halvings. The rule contains no price indicator and is independent of BTC SMA200-001.
pass_fail_gates: both complete tradeable halving windows have positive net return after entry and exit costs
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: SEC-filed Bitcoin disclosures identify observed halving dates/block heights including 2020-05-11 and 2024-04-20
Published event studies do not uniformly support a simple bullish halving story; therefore this is a falsifiable fixed event-window trial rather than an assumed anomaly
A single 365-calendar-day holding window is a fixed one-year supply-shock horizon; no alternate event-window search is permitted
selection_metric: No window search. For each already-observed halving, hold BTC only on execution dates strictly after the halving and no later than halving+365 calendar days. No estimated future halving may trigger exposure. Validation, objective and BTC buy-hold comparison are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes; final validation is capped at WEAK because only two complete tradeable halving windows exist in the frozen sample.

shared_rules.enter_rule: first common execution date strictly after halving
shared_rules.exit_rule: first common execution date after halving+365 calendar days

strategy_lineage: btc-halving-001 / 比特币减半供给冲击001; deterministic one-year post-halving exposure
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_btc_halving_001.py -> frozen Binance BTCUSDT + SEC halving dates + historical USD/CNY + immutable tools/btc_halving_001_logic.swift + SP500 calendar support -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace
validation_gates: validation evidence is capped at WEAK even if all gates pass because only two complete active event windows are present
